superseded_assumption: The user cannot extend the rental beyond three days.

recovery_policy.start: After initial completion; no additional optional experiments consume recovery reserve.
recovery_policy.scope: Rerun failed or invalidated paired cells and missing required checks. A full campaign rerun is not guaranteed; preserve successful immutable work and all failed attempts.

budget_constraint: The user can fund only this one rental. No extension, replacement rental or later paid campaign is assumed. Multiple experiments and timing repetitions must fit inside this allocation.

purchase_gate.reason: The completed published-baseline laptop gate is evidence of usefulness, not an end-to-end validation of this full server campaign. Freeze and locally smoke the executable queue, profiling, checkpoints and evidence export before starting the rental clock.
purchase_gate.completion_rule: Spend the one allocation on a fixed prioritized campaign. Drop optional cells by the prespecified budget rule and preserve incomplete outcomes; do not assume another rental.
purchase_gate.scientific_limit: One final paid allocation can be enforced. Completion of every proposed cell, publication acceptance and absence of future reviewer requests cannot be guaranteed.

paper_update_authorization: The user separately authorized an update of completed results while preserving methodology, introduction and abstract.

storage.policy: Runtime-focused installation; keep only needed active model/key profiles, avoid duplicate immutable keys, transfer and verify completed evidence before retiring rebuildable caches. Preserve proofs, verification keys, pins, approved tasks, manifests and all attempt receipts.
storage.guard_note: Existing laptop runner requires12GiB free. A smaller-disk server needs a separately specified and canary-validated temporary-write/reserve policy, not a silent reduction of the old guard.

prerental_readiness_required: Per-complete-response profiling including planning, key loads, moment link, switching, correction, Full and replay
Matched cost-aware implementation for PCA and centroid basis
Pinned inputs, three fits, unseen-as-applicable evaluation IDs, train-only unique proposals and executable hashes
Fixed online or known-batch semantics; all preflight work and nonresident key loads charged
Checkpointed bounded queue and independently verified public exports

primary.priority: Independent fits and paired timing blocks on a larger catalog precede long request sequences. Admit the frozen grid using server canaries and a conservative remaining-time ledger; no linear core speedup assumed.
primary.cold_setup_policy: Record fresh setup once per fit/profile; repeated warm request work is not a second cold-setup measurement.

component_study.real_proof_primary_contrast: Primary rank79 comparison is covered by the paired main grid. Add rank4 centroid versus PCA on N128, first4 proposals and one pinned fit only if the initial phase budget permits; retain native ranks/caps across all three fits.
component_study.interpretation: Native coverage is not proof runtime. Invalid security-removing variants are negative controls, not faster sound baselines.

scale.selection: Common feasibility and budget; no selection by certificate outcome or favorable speed ratio

long_case.projection_scope: Historical Q128 budget heuristic retained for traceability only; not the selected Q32 workload, an admission forecast or a server speed prediction. Excludes PCA, setup, repetitions and new server calibration.

questions.topic: Roles of geometry, summaries, interval arithmetic and refinement
Cold/warm amortization and observed per-baseline crossover
Time, memory, keys and proof-byte scaling
Difficult data, reference resets and cost-aware routing

reporting: Retain every prespecified win, loss, failure and unfinished cell. Never infer speedup from a missing comparator or promise universal superiority. Repeat timings do not create independent fits.
recommendation: Evidence supports a bounded regime-specific confirmation study, contingent on finishing executable preparation before the rental clock begins.
